editorial:
Imagine being a loyal soldier for twenty years only to have your boss throw you under the bus for a huge heist. That is exactly what happens to Merle, a gambling man who has had a run of bad luck for two decades. He is supposed to be the fall guy in a deadly setup, but he manages to survive the trap and escape with a gorgeous woman and some of the stolen cash. Instead of taking the money and running for the hills, Merle decides he wants revenge. He goes from being a quiet enforcer to a killing machine, turning the joke name The Butcher into a scary reality for everyone who crossed him.

Eric Roberts does a great job playing the lead, bringing a gritty energy that keeps you interested. The action is punchy and the revenge plot moves quickly, though some of the side characters feel a bit thin. If you love movies where a betrayed man comes back to settle the score, you will really enjoy this one. It is a solid pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Merle hunts down the people who betrayed him. After a series of violent clashes, he confronts the rival boss and the people who set him up. He uses his skills as The Butcher to eliminate his enemies one by one. In the end, Merle gets his revenge and secures the money. He walks away from the chaos with the woman he saved, finally ending his long losing streak.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and tough-guy action movies.
